parts.label: (i)
parts.answer: The line through $A$ and $B$ does not intersect $l$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: State a correct equation for $AB$ in any form, e.g. $\mathbf r=\mathbf i+\mathbf j+\mathbf k+\lambda(\mathbf i-\mathbf j+2\mathbf k)$, or equivalent — B1. Equate at least two pairs of components of $AB$ and $l$ and solve for $\lambda$ or $\mu$ — M1. Obtain a correct value, e.g. $\lambda=-1$ or $\mu=2$ — A1. Show that not all three equations are satisfied and that the lines do not intersect — A1. [Total: 4]

parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: EITHER: Find $\overrightarrow{AP}$ (or $\overrightarrow{PA}$) for a general point $P$ on $l$, e.g. $(1-\mu)\mathbf i+(-3+2\mu)\mathbf j+(-2+\mu)\mathbf k$ — B1. Calculate the scalar product of $\overrightarrow{AP}$ and a direction vector for $l$ and equate to zero — M1. Solve and obtain $\mu=\frac32$ — A1. Carry out a method to calculate $AP$ when $\mu=\frac32$ — M1. Obtain $\frac1{\sqrt2}$ correctly — A1. OR1: Find $\overrightarrow{AP}$ (or $\overrightarrow{PA}$) for a general point $P$ on $l$ — (B1. Use correct method to express $AP^2$ (or $AP$) in terms of $\mu$ — M1. Obtain e.g. $(1-\mu)^2+(-3+2\mu)^2+(-2+\mu)^2$ — A1. Carry out a complete method for finding its minimum — M1. Obtain the given answer correctly — A1). OR2: Calling $(2,-2,-1)$ $C$, state $\overrightarrow{AC}$ (or $\overrightarrow{CA}$) in component form, e.g. $\mathbf i-3\mathbf j-2\mathbf k$ — (B1. Use a scalar product to find the projection of $\overrightarrow{AC}$ (or $\overrightarrow{CA}$) on $l$ — M1. Obtain e.g. $\frac9{\sqrt6}$ — A1. Use Pythagoras to find the perpendicular — M1. Obtain the given answer correctly — A1). OR3: State $\overrightarrow{AC}$ (or $\overrightarrow{CA}$) in component form — (B1. Calculate vector product, e.g. $(\mathbf i-3\mathbf j-2\mathbf k)\times(-\mathbf i+2\mathbf j+\mathbf k)$ — M1. Obtain e.g. $\mathbf i+\mathbf j-\mathbf k$ — A1. Divide the modulus of the product by that of the direction vector — M1. Obtain the given answer correctly — A1). [Total: 5]
